Synopsis: Dialog with the real harper in Danthelon basement after saving him from a doppelganger ambush. He tells us how Jaheira's Harpers were infiltrated and killed, while he was forced to lure her into a trap. Jaheira will want to dismiss Geraldus for his own safety, but the player can intervene. Cluster Contexts: - WYR_Axe_RealHarper_Alive.json: The scene is set in Danthelon’s (Entharl’s) tavern/cellar just after the assault on the mind‑flayer colony: Jaheira and her Harper cell are sheltering below and the party has just recovered the real Harper Geraldus from a doppelganger ambush. Geraldus reports that shapeshifters working with the cult (linked to Orin the Red and Bhaalist agents) infiltrated Harper ranks, murdered some members (Chelvin among them) and used a false face to trick him into luring Jaheira. Jaheira, blaming herself for sending Harpers after the Rashemaar, worries Geraldus’s presence endangers Entharl’s tavern and wants him dismissed for everyone’s safety. The player is in a position to challenge her decision and argue that Geraldus should be allowed to choose whether to remain a Harper and keep fighting. - WYR_Axe_Harpers.json: Dialog with harpers in Danthelon's Dancing Axe basement ambush. A number of doppelgangers have slaughered a Harper troop and stolen their faces, forcing the one surviving Harper to set Jaheira up for an ambush.We can see the trap coming, or pick up on Jaheira's hint that all is not right. Either way, it ends in combat. - LOW_SerialKiller_DoppelgangerGiveQuest_Backup.json: Dialog that triggers when the players kill one person on the target list and they aren't part of the Bhaal Cult yet. context: The scene takes place in Entharl’s tavern cellar (Danthelon’s Dancing Axe) just after the ambush: Jaheira, other Harpers and the party have recovered the real Harper Geraldus from a doppelganger trap. Geraldus reports that shapeshifters tied to the cult — likely Bhaalists answering to Orin the Red — infiltrated Harper ranks, murdered several members (Chelvin among them) and used a stolen face to trick him into luring Jaheira. Jaheira, blaming herself for sending Harpers after the Rashemaar, fears Geraldus now endangers the tavern and wants him dismissed for everyone’s safety. Geraldus insists he still wants to serve and fight for his fallen comrades, and the player can intervene to argue he should be allowed to choose his own fate.
